title: On‑prem helm partial upgrade causing mixed nodeagent podspecs and KV cache divergence (customer 3249 escalation)
creator: Ava Chen
description:
Summary:
A paying Private/VPC customer (tenant 3249) reported intermittent API 503s immediately following a scheduled on‑prem operator/helm upgrade. The upgrade partially applied: a subset of nodeagent replicas were rolled forward to the new image and templated podspec while others remained on the previous spec. The mixed fleet caused a KV cache version skew and prefix cache mismatch; cross‑pod feature flags relied on a ConfigMap/annotation that changed shape between operator versions. Result: the leader pod accepted write traffic and populated a new cache format while older replicas continued serving reads expecting the old format, producing failed lookups and 503s under burst traffic.

Investigation notes:
- Timeline: 2026-03-09 02:13 UTC helm upgrade started; by 02:23 UTC support began seeing 503s.
- Root cause: two contributing issues in the operator/helm charts: (1) a template change that introduced nodeagent.enableNewKvFormat defaulting to true, and (2) the operator reconciler does not perform a coordinated KV schema migration or wait for an explicit post‑upgrade readiness gate.
- Race path: helm created a new ReplicaSet but rolling update strategy + node drain window led to a window where new and old nodeagent containers served traffic concurrently. The operator's reconcile loop performed a lightweight migration annotation but did not create a migration job or fence writes, so old replicas continued to read stale keys.
- Observability: dashboard grafana/private-3249/ops showed tokenized error spikes correlated to pod restart timestamps. Logs reveal JSON schema unmarshalling errors and 'unknown kv_version' traces in nodeagent.

Immediate mitigations applied (customer-facing):
- Rolled back the customer cluster to the pre‑upgrade helm release using our emergency rollback script (private-rollback.sh) for tenant 3249. This restored homogenous podspecs and removed 503s.
- Enabled temporary read‑only fallback on frontends for affected routes to reduce error surface while rollback completed.
- Opened direct Slack bridge between SRE, the customer, and Solutions Engineering.

Planned permanent fixes and rollout strategy:
1) Hot patch (v2026.03.1): operator reconciler will: (a) detect kv schema bump in values and annotate tenant CR with migration_in_progress, (b) create a migration Job that performs incremental KV conversion under a leader lock, (c) gate readiness until the job completes and all nodeagent replicas report the new kv_version.
2) Helm chart change: make nodeagent.enableNewKvFormat opt‑in (default false) for one release cycle and add a preflight check that fails the helm upgrade if any tenant's pod readiness times out beyond a configurable threshold.
3) Upgrade orchestration: introduce a staged canary plan that upgrades 2% of tenants per batch with an automated observation window for error budgets and rollout rollback triggers.
4) Add automated preflight: a kubectl/helm preflight hook that verifies consistent current podspec hashes across replicas and fails fast if drift is detected.

Testing & QA:
- Unit tests added to reconciler for migration annotation semantics.
- E2E: synthetic cluster test that simulates mixed ReplicaSet traffic and asserts no 503s during migration.
- Canary: first canary will be run in our internal staging cluster, followed by a small set of low‑latency customers, then broader rollout.

Runbook & customer ops:
- emergency_rollback.md updated with steps and telemetry queries to verify homogeneity.
- customer support template created for communicating status and ETA to affected customers.

Acceptance criteria:
- New operator is able to detect kv schema mismatches and perform coordinated migrations without exposing 503s in our staging stress tests.
- Helm preflight halts upgrades when per‑tenant podspec hash variance > 0 across replicas.
- Verified rollout for one internal canary tenant, no regressions for two weeks.

Next steps:
- PR for reconciler and migration job (linked below).
- Run canary in staging on 2026-03-17.
- Prepare customer communication bundle for tenants scheduled in the next 30 days.
